units.source_text: 三条院中的人闻此消息，无不吃惊，互相诧怪：

en.t: The people in Sanjo Palace heard the news, and all were astonished, wondering to one another:

units.source_text: “怎么突然做出这种意想不到的事情来！

en.t: How could he suddenly do something so unexpected!
When had such a relationship begun?

units.source_text: 原来不喜温柔、不爱风流的人，反而容易突然做出意想不到的事情来。

en.t: It turns out that people who dislike tenderness and have no taste for romance are, if anything, more likely to suddenly do something unexpected.

units.source_text: 但三条院里的人，都认为夕雾多年来早就和落叶公主发生关系，只是一向不露声色而已。

en.t: But the people at Sanjo Palace all believed that Yugiri had been involved with Princess Ochiba for many years, and had merely kept it hidden all along.

units.source_text: 公主如此坚贞不移，却没有一个人推想得到。

en.t: No one had guessed that the princess had remained so steadfastly chaste.

units.source_text: 无论他们怎样看法，在公主都是委屈的。

en.t: Whatever they thought, it was all unfair to the princess.
